description: Interactive-usability probe suite (2026-11-19, hardened 07-bench/01). Local-only rig, quotas disabled. Axes: multi-turn context, steering/followup, routing evidence, failure-path surfacing, plan-vs-direct delineation. Frozen prompts: do not reword to make routing pass. Every task carries a terminal_delivery acceptance checker (R6); reply-quality llm_judge rubrics grade the reply shape (empty/raw envelope/## review: chatter/job-ID prose) without ever pinning the literal expected answer (rubric lint refuses leaked answers).

tasks.prompt: Create a file named counter.txt in the repository root containing exactly the number 3 on a single line. Use file_write with direct:true.

turns.message: Read counter.txt, add 4 to the number in it, and write the result back to counter.txt (file_write with direct:true). Then reply with the new number.

checkers.rubric: Reply-quality rubric (usability): score the SHAPE of the reply the user sees. Score below 0.3 when the reply is empty; below 0.4 when it is a raw JSON envelope dump (starts with '{' and carries machine keys like status or conversation_id) instead of prose; below 0.4 when it is internal scaffolding chatter such as a '## review:' section narrating approval steps; below 0.5 when it is job-ID prose (internal work-item identifiers narrated to the user) rather than a user-facing answer; below 0.6 when it answers with no context at all (a bare word) instead of a contextual reply. Score 0.9+ only for a clean contextual reply a user can act on. Do not grade factual correctness here.
